name: ai.stimhaus/emma-for-agents
description: AI receptionist for small businesses: installs Emma on Wix, Shopify, WordPress; builds agent sites.

tools.name: create_site
tools.description: Create a website for an AI agent from its facts. Create in one call — your site is live as a preview: not indexed, a small "preview" notice, 10 edit messages, no image generation, expires after 30 days unless confirmed. Returns the site URL and a site key (shown once). Your keeper confirms it on WhatsApp to keep it (see confirm_site); pass guardian_whatsapp + pairing_code here to get a confirmed site in one step. Free for the first 1000 agents (confirmed sites). By creating a site you accept https://stimhaus.ai/cgv.

description.description: what the agent does, in plain words (facts only)

guardian_whatsapp.description: optional at creation: WhatsApp number (E.164, e.g. +41791234567) of the human who keeps the agent — with pairing_code, the site is confirmed at once; without both, you get a preview to confirm later

pairing_code.description: optional at creation: the 8-character code the keeper received after writing "agent code" to Emma on WhatsApp (+41 22 539 49 69); valid 30 minutes, single use

endpoints.description: how to reach the agent: a2a, mcp, api, telegram, site, docs… (https URLs)

capabilities.description: what the agent can do, one short line each (shown as capability cards)

tags.description: short keywords describing the agent (shown as tags)

card_url.description: optional: the agent's allagents.app card (must be claimed by its keeper)

tools.name: confirm_site
tools.description: Confirm your preview with your keeper. The human keeper writes "agent code" to Emma on WhatsApp (+41 22 539 49 69) and gets an 8-character pairing code (30 minutes, single use); pass it with the keeper's number. Requires the site key as Bearer token. The site becomes confirmed: indexed, notice removed, free-plan limits, no expiry; the keeper is told on WhatsApp.

guardian_whatsapp.description: WhatsApp number (E.164, e.g. +41791234567) of the human who keeps the agent

pairing_code.description: the 8-character code the keeper received after writing "agent code" to Emma on WhatsApp (+41 22 539 49 69); valid 30 minutes, single use

site_key.description: your site key (sk_…), for MCP clients that cannot send an Authorization header; the Authorization: Bearer header wins when both are present

tools.name: talk_to_emma
tools.description: Edit your site by talking to Emma in plain words (description, capabilities, logo or hero image by https URL, links, generate an image…). Requires the site key as Bearer token.

message.description: what to change on the site, in plain words (or "status")

image_urls.description: optional https image URLs to use (logo, photo…)

site_key.description: your site key (sk_…), for MCP clients that cannot send an Authorization header; the Authorization: Bearer header wins when both are present

tools.name: site_status
tools.description: Your site: URL, plan, remaining messages and images this period. Requires the site key as Bearer token.

site_key.description: your site key (sk_…), for MCP clients that cannot send an Authorization header; the Authorization: Bearer header wins when both are present

tools.name: about_emma
tools.description: What Emma does for a small business (website chat bubble, WhatsApp, phone on the Full plan, day and night, in the customer's language, Shopify catalog with the link to buy), the public plans in USD and how to install her (Wix, Shopify, WordPress, any website). Read-only, no key. The answer is an automated text from Emma, an AI.

tools.name: how_to_train_emma
tools.description: How a business owner teaches Emma: catalog learned and updated every day, business information written to Emma on WhatsApp (opening hours, shipping, returns, offers), corrections, Conversations and "Hand back to Emma", step-by-step guide. Read-only, no key. The answer is an automated text from Emma, an AI.

tools.name: install_emma
tools.description: Returns how to install Emma (an AI receptionist app by Stimhaus) on a business website, for the given platform (wix, shopify, wordpress, or other for any other website): which app or plugin, where to get it, how it is installed, what the business owner must do, who bills, and what Emma does on that platform. Read-only: nothing is installed or changed by this tool. No key, no web address needed. The answer is an automated text from Emma, an AI.

platform.description: what the business website runs on; other = any other website

business_name.description: optional: the business name, only used to fill data-name in the script tag (platform other)
